profil_visi_misi.profil_text: Pondok Pesantren Pulo Melati didirikan atas restu para sesepuh ulama Nusantara dengan komitmen melahirkan santri yang tafaqquh fiddin, mandiri, dan berwawasan masa depan. Memadukan kedalaman kajian Turats Salafiyah dengan keunggulan sains modern.
profil_visi_misi.visi: Menjadi episentrum peradaban santri yang kokoh dalam tauhid, mutqin dalam Al-Qur'an, unggul dalam adab dan sains, serta memimpin perubahan ummat.
misi_points: Menyelenggarakan halaqah Tahfidzul Qur'an 30 Juz bersanad muttashil.
Mengkaji kitab-kitab turats mu'tabarah secara komprehensif (nahwu, sharaf, fiqh, tasawwuf).
Menanamkan budaya bilingual (Arab & Inggris) sebagai bahasa komunikasi harian.
Membekali santri dengan kecakapan teknologi, kepemimpinan, dan kewirausahaan mandiri.

admin_dashboard_module.auth: JWT-based authentication with demo-friendly direct access and preset credentials ('admin' / 'pesantren123')
crud_features: Pendaftar PSB: View submissions list, filter by status (Pending, Terverifikasi, Ujian Masuk, Diterima, Ditolak), update status, search by name/whatsapp, download or print tanda bukti pendaftaran, and open direct WhatsApp chat with prospective parents.
Manajemen Berita & Artikel: Add, edit, delete news articles with title, category (Kegiatan, Prestasi, Ta'lim, Info PSB), content, date, and image.
Manajemen Galeri Foto: Add, filter, delete photos with category (Kegiatan, Santri, Fasilitas, Acara).
Manajemen Program Pendidikan: Edit nama program, deskripsi kurikulum, dan akreditasi.
Manajemen Pengasuh & Ustadz: CRUD data dewan pengajar, spesialisasi keilmuan, dan foto.
Manajemen Testimoni: CRUD testimoni wali santri dan alumni sukses.
Stat Counters Editor: Live update angka Santri, Alumni, Asatidz, dan Tahun berdiri.

Filterable Media Gallery with instant tab switches (Semua, Kegiatan, Santri, Fasilitas, Acara)
News reader detail modal / dedicated route so prospective parents can read real updates about pondok activities
Instant Search and Status Filter inside the Admin PSB Management table
Export / Print Proof of Registration (Tanda Bukti Pendaftaran PSB) with generated registration number e.g. 'PSB-2026-089'
Toggle between Public View and Admin Dashboard effortlessly

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_first: Prospective parents in Indonesia browse mostly on mobile devices (Android/iOS). Ensure touch targets >= 44px, sticky header is light & crisp, and form inputs are legible with clear labels.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_harmony: Use Deep Forest Green (#134e3f) with Warm Sand / Ivory surfaces, accented with Warm Amber/Gold (#d97706) for Islamic heritage dignity. Avoid harsh artificial neon colors or generic cold SaaS blue.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_integrity: Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky navigation or dropdowns. Use 'bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md' with subtle 1px border. All text on dark emerald backgrounds must be crisp white (#ffffff) or soft gold (#fef3c7).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.whatsapp_integration: Make WhatsApp deep-links authentic and functional: 'https://wa.me/6281234567890?text=Assalamu%27alaikum%20Panitia%20PSB%20Pondok%20Pesantren%20Pulo%20Melati...' so wali santri can instantly consult.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_persistence: Store registrations, articles, gallery items, and testimonials in modern React state + localStorage (and backend API if connected) so testing can see newly submitted registrations appear immediately inside the Admin Dashboard table.
